configuration.detection: threshold=0.2; boxThreshold=0.4 tiny_det, 0.45 otherwise; unclipRatio=1.4; minSize=3; maxCandidates=3000; verticalRatio=1.5
configuration.timing: Wall milliseconds include existing pure preprocessing, DB decode/crops, ONNX detect+recognize, CTC and ordering. Model initialization and one en-scan warm-up per pairing are excluded.
configuration.cer: Levenshtein edits / reference Unicode code points after NFC and folding all whitespace runs to one ASCII space; trimmed.
configuration.wer: Levenshtein edits / reference whitespace-delimited tokens after the same normalization; Japanese has no morphological tokenization.
configuration.detectionRecallProxy: Maximum-IoU-first greedy one-to-one matching of axis-aligned bounding boxes of GT and predicted quads; matched GT boxes with IoU >= 0.30 / all GT boxes. Proxy only: no polygon IoU or precision.
configuration.practicality: practical: recall>=0.80 and CER<=0.15; marginal: recall>=0.50 and CER<=0.40; otherwise not practical.
